Name: Hentai Trees AT Conversion
Author: natsuninja
Description:
I've been playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7496]AmraCumango's Hentai Trees[/url] mod for a while, but there were 3 things I wished I could do with it
[list=1]
[*]Not have to choose between the three different versions
[*]Mix and match with lewd dryad trees and normal looking trees.﻿
[*]Use other tree texture mods alongside it.

[/list]So by converting the mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] I was able to do all these things.

Manifest.Name: Hentai Trees AT Conversion
Manifest.Description: An AT content pack for Hentai Trees!
